query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as remaining_duplicates,
  SUM(dup_count - 1) as remaining_to_delete
FROM (
  SELECT 
    cardId, source, grade, jpyPrice,
    COUNT(*) as dup_count
  FROM priceHistory
  WHERE source = 'snkrdunk' AND jpyPrice IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY cardId, source, grade, jpyPrice
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
    AND DATEDIFF(MAX(soldAt), MIN(soldAt)) <= 7
) t;
